Faderwake bundles local builds of FFmpeg and FFprobe from the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org).
The tools are built from unmodified FFmpeg 8.1.3 sources, licensed under LGPL version 2.1 or later.
The complete corresponding source archive and build recipe accompany the Faderwake source
distribution in vendor/ffmpeg-8.1.3.tar.xz and tools/prepare-codecs.sh.
Source archive: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.3.tar.xz
SHA-256: 7138d28c96d9d3e3af4ee3d8cad72741f8ffb40da90c1112235dea3ecd3178a3
See FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt for the full license.
